# subroutines used correctly: a branch inside one, and a call that returns to a label
@scene Library · now | fade 900
@set late = yes
@call recall
@call recall return ending

@label recall
@if late -> recall_late
Laila (neutral): She almost has it.
@return

@label recall_late
Laila (neutral): Too late to remember.
@return

@label ending
@end Done
